facts.text: Original - 3 Layered BodyIQ Orthopedic Memory Foam Mattress - Grey

It uses a three-layer system: a soft foam top layer for comfort, a BodyIQ Orthopedic Memory Foam layer that adapts to your body and relieves pressure, and a high-resilient foam base for strong support and durability.
Original is a medium firm mattress featuring Sleepyhead’s BodyIQ Orthopedic Memory Foam technology.
Personalized comfort with BodyIQ Technology: Adapts intelligently to each body position, providing tailored support throughout the night.
Our mattress features an exceptional quality known as zero motion transfer, made possible by the remarkable properties of memory foam.
Yes, it comes with a 10-year warranty and a 100-night free trial.
